mapper.select: SELECT TO_CHAR(P.PROJ_ID) AS SCOPE_ID, TO_CHAR(P.PROJ_ID) AS SCOPE_CODE, P.PROJ_NM AS SCOPE_NAME, TO_CHAR(P.PROJ_ID) || ' - ' || P.PROJ_NM AS LABEL FROM TB_PROJECT P ORDER BY P.PROJ_NM, P.PROJ_ID

SELECT P.PROJ_ID, P.PROJ_NM, P.PROJ_BGNG_YMD, P.PROJ_END_YMD, P.PROJ_STAT_CD, LDR.EMP_NM AS PROJ_LDR_NM, P.PROJ_LDR_EMP_ID, P.PROJ_PRGRS_RT, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_PROJ_MEMBER PM2 WHERE PM2.PROJ_ID = P.PROJ_ID AND PM2.LEAVE_DT IS NULL ) AS MEMBER_CNT, CASE WHEN P.PROJ_STAT_CD = '02' AND P.PROJ_END_YMD <= TRUNC(SYSDATE) + 7 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS DEADLINE_RISK, PM.EMP_ID, MBR.EMP_NM, D.DEPT_NM FROM TB_PROJECT P JOIN TB_EMPLOYEE LDR ON LDR.EMP_ID = P.PROJ_LDR_EMP_ID LEFT JOIN TB_PROJ_MEMBER PM ON PM.PROJ_ID = P.PROJ_ID AND PM.LEAVE_DT IS NULL LEFT JOIN TB_EMPLOYEE MBR ON MBR.EMP_ID = PM.EMP_ID LEFT JOIN TB_DEPARTMENT D ON D.DEPT_CD = MBR.DEPT_CD ORDER BY CASE WHEN P.PROJ_STAT_CD = '02' AND P.PROJ_END_YMD <= TRUNC(SYSDATE) + 7 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, P.PROJ_CREAT_DT DESC
